## Context
The rebar 0.11.0 post-release check proved that `gh attestation verify <wheel> --repo navapbc/rebar` cannot verify the PEP 740 bundle produced by pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish. The command queries GitHub Artifact Attestations for SLSA provenance; the publish action uploads a `https://docs.pypi.org/attestations/publish/v1` bundle to PyPI. The official `pypi-attestations verify pypi` command validates the published wheel successfully.

## Plan
- Add a regression oracle for the documented provenance-verification command/semantics.
- Replace the incorrect GitHub-store verifier in docs/releasing.md with the authoritative PyPI PEP 740 verifier and correct the matching release-workflow comment.
- Preserve the separate GitHub immutable-release attestation semantics without conflating them with PyPI provenance.
- Run focused documentation/workflow tests and the relevant gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The runbook verifies a downloaded PyPI artifact with the official PyPI attestation verifier and repository identity.
- [x] The runbook no longer claims that a GitHub SLSA lookup proves the PyPI PEP 740 bundle.
- [x] The release workflow comment names the correct consumer verifier and store.
- [x] A regression test protects the documented command and predicate/store distinction.
- [x] Focused tests, lint, and typecheck pass.
